description:
Welcome to Agro-Spectra! 🌾🛰️

 We tackle the NASA challenge "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" by merging NASA's satellite data (NDVI, soil moisture) with AI to optimize farming. 

We seek passionate members in:

- Communications & Storytelling (Pitching)

- Data Analysis & Visualization

- Earth Science & Agriculture

- AI & Satellite Remote Sensing

Join us to turn space data into real agricultural solutions!
